# Generic example: like today's transactions from roommates
profile = apis.supervisor.show_profile()
creds = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
phone_token = apis.phone.login(username=creds['phone']['username'], password=creds['phone']['password'])
contacts = []
page = 0
while True:
    batch = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query='roommates', relationship='roommates', page_index=page)
    if not batch:
        break
    contacts.extend(batch)
    page += 1
emails = {c['email'] for c in contacts}
start = apis.phone.get_current_date_and_time()  # example: use to compute today boundaries
# ... compute start/end ...
venmo_token = apis.venmo.login(username=creds['venmo']['username'], password=creds['venmo']['password'])
page = 0
while True:
    feed = apis.venmo.show_social_feed(access_token=venmo_token, page_index=page)
    if not feed:
        break
    for entry in feed:
        if start <= entry.created_at <= end and (entry.sender.email in emails or entry.receiver.email in emails):
            apis.venmo.like_transaction(transaction_id=entry.transaction_id, access_token=venmo_token)
    page += 1
apis.supervisor.complete_task(status='success')
